title: Check  the size - they’re small!
text: Check  the size - they’re small!. Good lesson on reading the fine print - these are 6 really lovely very small spoons - not for cooking  or kitchen use - these spoons are alternatives for metal spoons.  They might come in handy in a picnic situation where you don’t want to bring breakable things - or for a special effect with a different sort of dessert.  We’ll hang on to them - bu we really needed kitchen wooden spoons!
